text:
sam_support: FYI customer on Enterprise says their tool/function calls stopped working after switching to our OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Getting a 400 with "incompatible_tool_call: expected 'tool' object, got 'tool_name' and 'params'". Also they report assistant text fallback (no tool invocation) and a token billing spike. Repro steps I got below.

eli_se: Can you paste the exact request payload they send?

sam_support: Pasting client request (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Please run price_check for sku 123"}],
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "tool_name": "price_checker",
      "params": {"sku": "123"}
    }
  ]
}
```

sam_support: They also have an older client that sometimes stringifies params, e.g. `"params": "{\"sku\":\"123\"}"`.

eli_se: Ok. Our OpenAI-compatible spec expects tool calls like: `[{"name":..., "arguments": {...}}]` (name+arguments). We ship a compat normalizer to alias common variants, but it looks like it didn't handle `tool_name`/`params` + stringified args combination.

sunil_infra: I pulled logs from the normalizer for that session. We see: `compat:received_tool_call variant=tool_name_params` then `compat:parse_error details=JsonParseError at arguments`. When parse fails we currently drop to assistant text fallback (intended to avoid throwing), which is why the customer saw plain assistant output and higher token usage.

sam_support: Customer quote: "We sent a tool call; the assistant just responded with a sentence and then charged us for extra tokens. We expected a structured tool invocation." They flagged billing as urgent.

kim_pm: This seems to be both a schema mismatch (field names) and an encoding mismatch (params stringified). We should offer a quick workaround and a longer-term fix. Quick workaround = ask them to upgrade SDK or send canonical `name`+`arguments`. Also we can add a temporary gateway mapping for this customer.

eli_se: Short-term mitigation: we can accept `tool_name` -> `name` and `params` -> `arguments`. For stringified `params` we can attempt JSON.parse if we detect a string. That would convert `"params": "{\"sku\":\"123\"}"` to an object. But need to be careful: this could be abused if arguments are intentionally strings. We'll add heuristic: only auto-parse if the string looks like JSON (starts with `{` or `[`).

sunil_infra: Note: there's also an envelope variation where some clients wrap tool calls under `toolCalls` vs `tool_calls`. Our normalizer already handles camelCase vs snake_case, but not the `tool_name` key. I'll open a small patch.

deploy-bot: deploy: production/compat-normalizer v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4 started by @sunil_infra at 2026-03-08T15:34:12Z

sunil_infra: Patch pushed: added aliases for `tool_name` -> `name`, `params` -> `arguments`, and a guarded parse for stringified arguments. Added a feature-flag so we can enable per-customer. Rolling to 10% now.

eli_se: I'll write unit tests covering combinations: (1) name+arguments object, (2) tool_name+params object, (3) tool_name+params stringified JSON, (4) mixed casing, (5) malicious string that looks like JSON but is textual.

kim_pm: Priority: P1 for this customer due to billing impact. Sam, please get their SDK version and whether they use any proxy that might alter payloads (e.g., stringify). Also confirm whether they saw assistant fallback for all calls or just a subset.

sam_support: On it. I've asked for SDK version, example requests that failed, and whether they can test the patch behind a canary flag. I'll reply here when they confirm.

eli_se: One more note: we should update docs in `docs/api/tool-calls.md` to list common noncompliant shapes we've seen and examples for SDK authors to avoid these fallbacks.

sam_support: Customer replied: SDK=redwood-sdk-js v0.9.1 (old), they use a middleware that stringifies body for legacy reasons. They agreed to try a canary flag. They also provided one failed response snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "incompatible_tool_call",
    "message": "expected 'tool' object with 'name' and 'arguments'"
  }
}
```

sunil_infra: Thanks. I'll enable the per-customer compat flag for their account and continue the rollout if telemetry looks good.

kim_pm: Good. Please track the billing delta and confirm token usage drops once they use the canary. Also file a postmortem if this pattern recurs across more accounts.

sam_support: Will do. Closing loop when customer confirms canary/upgrade works. :thumbsup:
